claim.text: Daily vitamin Q supplementation prevents seasonal colds.

cited_papers.title: A small pilot study of vitamin Q and cold incidence (SYNTHETIC)
cited_papers.text: In this pilot of 40 adults, those taking vitamin Q reported somewhat fewer colds than controls, but the difference was not statistically significant. The study was not powered to detect an effect; larger trials are needed.
